build_provenance.source_scope: The earlier frozen staged smoke fixture predates bounded sampler diagnostics and the explicit exit-progress fix. This measurement did not rebuild it and is separate from the later fixed/auto matrix executable.

measurement.state_roots: Eight new independent protected state roots, one per witness-client fixture.
measurement.fixture_branch: witness-client awaits owner.ready(), retains the returned guard and then waits forever; it launches no native commands.
measurement.rss_source: /bin/ps RSS in KiB, multiplied by 1024; aggregate is the sum of process RSS and can count shared pages more than once.
rss_probe_argv_shape: <all eight client and eight helper PIDs>
measurement.identity_and_lifetime_checks: Every sample requires live fixture clients, stable endpoint PID/generation, non-zombie helper/client rows, unchanged helper-to-client and client-to-runner ancestry, and held owner.lock lifetime witnesses.

controls.native_access: Expanded native access was used for this measurement.
controls.fixture_environment: EJM_FIXTURE_ variables were removed before creating clients.

cleanup.method: Kill and reap only the exact Popen client objects created by this runner; then observe every helper PID absent and every lifetime witness lock available.

limits: Sampled high-water RSS can miss peaks between samples.
Fixture clients are not CLI, worker or IDE hosts.
No active commands, descendants, saturated retained table, registry pool enforcement or physical-footprint peak is measured.
The eight helpers use separate isolated state roots and no shared helper registry. This does not test the eight-slot registry limit, committed generation reclamation or pool enforcement.
The first observation and 250 ms settled sampling do not measure an RSS startup peak. Sampled RSS high-water values can miss intervening peaks.
RSS sums can count shared pages more than once and are not aggregate physical footprint or private memory.
Only this earlier frozen smoke executable and this macOS arm64 host were measured. No other executable, real CLI/worker/IDE parent, hardware or operating-system result is established.
No helper allowance, automatic default or saturation gate is validated by these idle observations alone.
